verdict.rationale: Unleash's API/token model supports least-privilege access: backend tokens are scoped to a project and single environment, RBAC (including custom project/root roles) further restricts access, and frontend tokens are explicitly non-secret — this token scoping mechanism would apply to any client, including an AI agent connecting via the documented MCP server. However, there's no agent-specific guidance for issuing/rotating scoped credentials for AI agents specifically (e.g., dedicated 'agent token' type or docs tying MCP usage to scoped tokens). Missing for 10: explicit documentation on scoping/rotating credentials specifically for AI agents or MCP connections, and independent/hands-on confirmation of least-privilege enforcement in practice.
